context:
Goal: a lane's reviewed `Drops-lines:` excuse passes every check that reads it, the same way.
Problem (rule): decision silent-undo-check-design says "Merge tool only: the CLI and CI pass no PR body ... CI's way out is a `Drops-lines` commit trailer." So a `Drops-lines:` line in a PR body passes the merge tool, but CI and the lane lint fail it. On #1785, a body line failed the lane lint twice. Changing a recorded decision needs your word (stale-decision protocol, raised by lane notes-fix-page).
Based on (read): main's docs/decisions/silent-undo-check-design.md, lines 24-25, read by triage at 05:04 CST Nov 8. That sentence kept one reader of the body and no CI env plumbing.
Based on (ruling): item 165 a (owner): a lane's dropped work is excused by the existing `Drops-lines` line. It did not say where the line may sit.
Based on (ruling): your words at 13:20 CST Nov 7, "a found gap gets a fix, not a note". The merge-only reader leaves the gap measured on #1785. The merge tool's own body reading is the same widening, and you may rule that it goes too.
Departs from: main, where a `Drops-lines:` body line passes only the merge tool and no remedy says where the excuse goes — every remedy and docstring says it goes in a commit trailer (b), or the CLI also reads the body through merge/merge.py's reader (a).
Meanwhile: the lane holds its builder on this step and keeps working its other PRs. #1785 uses a commit trailer.

options.gain: One rule everywhere, so a body line stops failing CI and the lane lint. Draft #1712 already passes the PR body to CI for Retire-run cites.
options.how: The silent-undo CLI reads the PR body through merge/merge.py's reader: env PR_BODY in CI, `--pr-body` locally. Decision silent-undo-check-design is rewritten in place to say every reader takes the body.
options.label: The CLI reads the body through the merge tool's reader
options.lose: CI and the lane lint accept a second form of the excuse. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

options.gain: No new accepted form in CI or the lane lint, and no CI change. Each lane writes the excuse in the one form every reader takes.
options.how: The decision stays. Every remedy and docstring says a `Drops-lines:` excuse goes in a commit trailer. A lane writes its excuse there.
options.label: Keep the decision; a `Drops-lines:` excuse goes in a commit trailer
options.lose: The merge tool still reads the body form, so a body line still passes at merge and fails in CI until you rule on that reader too.

ref: docs/decisions/silent-undo-check-design.md (lines 24-25 on main); step silent-undo-cli-ignores-pr-body; step silent-undo-ci-body (#1712); #1785
short: Drops-lines in the PR body: read it everywhere
title: Should the silent-undo check read a `Drops-lines:` excuse in the PR body in CI and the lane lint too, not only in the merge tool?
